name: Avoid Procedures with High Fan-In (Easytrieve)
description:
Avoid Procedures with High Fan-In (Fan-In > X). The Fan-In of an Artifact is the number of other Artifacts that are referencing it. When computing the Fan-In of an Artifact, multiple accesses to it from the same Artifact are counted as one access.
The threshold level is a parameter that can be changed at will.
For an Easytrieve Procedure, these Artifacts are the Program and the other Procedures that run it with PERFORM, or name it in START, FINISH or RESTART.
output:
Associated to each Easytrieve Procedure with violations, the Quality Rule provides:
- The Fan-In
rationale:
An Artifact referenced by many other Artifacts is costly to change: a change can impact all of them, and all of them have to be tested again.
Changeability and testability decline with increasing Fan-In.
reference: Standard suggestions based on CAST Quality Model
remediation: Review the design of the Procedure: split it into smaller Procedures with a single responsibility each, so that each caller depends only on what it uses.
